title: Western Australian Premier's University Scholarship
program_type: State government scholarship, administered by the participating universities
duration: One year of funding, credited against the recipient's fee and tuition account after the University census date for the semester applied for
description: The Western Australian Premier's University Scholarship is a Western Australian Government award that provides high-achieving international students with $50,000 towards their course fees and other university costs at one of Western Australia's five universities. Ten recipients are selected annually, with two awarded at each university. Applicants must be new offshore international students, citizens of one of 22 listed countries, and must apply directly to their chosen university, which assesses applications and selects the recipients. title: La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship
program_type: Automatic tuition fee discount for high-achieving international students
duration: Tuition fee discount for the duration of the course, applied each semester or each year as set out in the Letter of Offer
description: The La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship rewards high-achieving international students with a reduction of up to 25% off annual tuition fees for the duration of their course. Applicants are automatically considered after submitting an application for a course on the University's list of eligible courses, and the percentage awarded is set by weighted average mark: 20% for a WAM of 60 to 74.9 and 25% for a WAM of 75 or above. The scholarship is open from 10 February 2026 to 31 December 2027 for full fee-paying, non-sponsored international students who are not humanitarian or permanent visa holders

title: SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF)
program_type: University-funded doctoral fellowship for faculty members from developing countries
duration: Tuition exemption for a maximum of 6 semesters; monthly living expenses for 3 to 4 years
description: The SNU President Fellowship Program is one of Seoul National University's most prestigious scholarship programmes, launched to provide opportunities for teaching and instructional staff members of universities in developing countries to pursue PhD degrees at SNU. Approximately 8 recipients are awarded each semester. Benefits include full tuition exemption for a maximum of 6 semesters, monthly living expenses of 1,500,000 to 2,000,000 KRW for 3 to 4 years, a round-trip economy airfare, Korean language training, and reimbursement of National Health Insurance fees. title: KAIST Scholarship (KAIST International Undergraduate Admission)
official_source: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Office of Admissions
duration: Tuition exemption for 8 semesters (the published cost table describes the KAIST Scholarship as covering the entire tuition fee for 4 years once admitted)
description: KAIST awards its scholarship automatically to every admitted international undergraduate student, with no separate application: the applicant simply ticks "KAIST scholarship" on the Statement of Financial Resources section of the admission application. The award pays tuition exemption for 8 semesters, a living allowance of 350,000 KRW per month, and medical health insurance. It is not full funding: KAIST's own cost table shows the scholarship offsets 11,738,360 KRW of a 14,885,680 KRW essential annual budget, leaving roughly 3,359,000 KRW per year for housing, food and books.

title: KAIST Scholarship (KAIST International Graduate Admission)
official_source: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Office of Admissions
duration: 4 regular semesters, being the two years of a standard KAIST master's programme. For a Master's-Ph.D. Integrated programme the renewal position is not stated on this page.
description: KAIST's own scholarship for international graduate students, selected as part of the admission application rather than as a separate scholarship application. It covers full tuition fees plus national health insurance and a monthly stipend, and 94% of KAIST's international student body receive it. Two higher tiers are awarded automatically to those selected: the KAIST Global Presidential Scholarship (KRW 1,000,000 per month for 4 regular semesters) and the KAIST Prestige Scholarship for International Ph.D. Students (KRW 300,000 per month for 8 regular semesters).
